approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Two limits cap uploads. YouTube's channel limit: 10 in any 24 hours until the channel has Advanced features (daily_limit counts it). The YouTube Data API quota: 10,000 units a day (resets 08:00 UK), one upload costs 1,600, so 6 a day; per_session 6 matches it, and anything over waits for the reset. After the quota extension and Advanced features: daily_limit and per_session 20, slot_first 08:00, slot_every_minutes 45, slots_per_day 20, and a second writer run at 12:50.
